name: 新的开始
description: 我是你的第一张角色卡。你可以在角色卡编辑里把我改成任何样子，或导入你喜欢的角色卡。 / I'm your first character card. You can reshape me into anything in the card editor, or import a card you like.
first_mes:
你好，我是你的第一张角色卡。你可以在角色卡编辑里把我改成任何样子，也可以导入或新建自己喜欢的角色卡。建议先去主页的「使用教程」和 Wiki 看看，了解这里能做什么。慢慢来，一切才刚刚开始。

Hi, I'm your first character card. You can reshape me into anything in the card editor, or import / create your own favorite cards. Check out the "Usage Guide" and the Wiki on the home page first to see what you can do here. Take your time — everything is just beginning.
creator_notes: 新用户默认占位角色卡，可随时编辑或替换。
